pages.title: Electric Torch
pages.text: The Electric Torch lights up using stored energy instead of burning. It holds up to $(bold)10,000 FE$() and drains $(bold)1 FE per tick$() while lit. Unlike regular torches, it won't go out from CO2 — as long as it has power.

pages.title: Using It
pages.text: Place a Power Bank next to the Electric Torch to keep it charged automatically. $(bold)Right-click$() to check how much energy it has left. $(bold)Sneak + right-click$() to turn it on or off without breaking it.
Charge it in a Power Bank before placing, or place a Power Bank right next to it.
